title: Query fields
entryHelp: Configure the stored values used as query inputs to look up external data. Profile sync separately maps returned output fields.
help: Query inputs identify the external record to read. They do not select which returned fields update local profiles.

authority.native-profile: Updates profile fields under the existing field policies.
authority.profile: Reads additional properties under the existing property and claim rules.
authority.metadata: Checks contact verification under its own trust rules.
authority.lifecycle-status: Reads source account status under the existing eligibility rules.
authority.recovery-identity-verification: Checks submitted identity evidence during account recovery.
authority.password-sync: Updates the source password only through the existing password sync flow.

legacyHelp: Keeps the existing lookup and connection settings.
noSources: No available data sources. Ask the deployment administrator to check service availability and trust.
blocked: This saved selection is unavailable. It remains saved but cannot be used until the source or fields are corrected.
multipleSources: Multiple sources are saved for this service. Choose one source to replace them; no source is selected automatically.
profileSourcesHelp: Each named source has its own lookup. Choose another source to add or review it.
saveHelp: Saving only updates these settings. It does not fetch data or update profiles. Connection and trust settings are managed separately.
readOnly: You can view these settings. Editing requires settings update permission.
draftKept: Your draft is kept. Reload the latest settings before saving again.

approval.title: Account approval
approval.help: Approve stored values when needed. Employee IDs with trusted source history can be used without manual approval.
approval.saveFirst: Save query settings before reviewing account approval.
approval.readRequired: Viewing account approval also requires account read permission.
approval.writeRequired: Changing approval requires both settings and account update permissions.
approval.searchPlaceholder: Enter an account name or email
approval.notApproved: No explicit approval for the current stored values.
approval.confirm: I have verified that the current stored values and this account's person association match this data source.
approval.algorithm: I have verified the stored document hash's origin and matching algorithm.
approval.algorithmHelp: The existing hash must use the same normalization and SHA-256 algorithm as the source. A hash-shaped value alone is insufficient. Values are read on the server.

errors.session: Your session expired. Sign in again.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission for this action.
errors.conflict: The settings or account have changed. Reload before continuing.
errors.source_unavailable: This data source is unavailable. Check the saved query settings and deployment.
errors.invalid_mapping: Choose a supported field combination and a value source for every field.
errors.invalid_stored_state: The saved settings cannot be read. Ask an administrator to check them.
errors.missing_input: The account is missing a required stored value, or its format is invalid.
errors.algorithm_approval_required: Confirm the stored document hash's origin and matching algorithm.
errors.not_found: This account is no longer available.
errors.request_failed: The request could not be completed. Try again.

empty: No external query sources or saved selections.

reasons.invalid_configuration: Deployment configuration is incomplete or invalid.
reasons.unsupported_inputs: No supported query input combination is available.
reasons.source_unavailable: Source unavailable. Ask a deployment administrator to check its configuration.

legacyStatus: Existing method; neutral query is not selected.
